summary:
GROUND PULSE is an app that collects, processes and transforms NISAR
radar data from the Granada Basin into clear and accessible visual
information, helping people explore ground changes and understand
complex satellite observations more easily.
details:
GROUND PULSE is an interactive web application designed to make NISAR radar observations easier to

access, visualize and understand.

Our project focuses on the Granada region, using satellite observations to explore ground deformation

and changes in the Earth's surface.

For coding, we used Python to procese and analyze all the NASA data we found. Next, we used streamlit to build the interactive app. Besides, we uploaded several online open source libraries.
